subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix polls with more than 20 supplied options be silently truncated at the event-builder boundary, rather than rejected with an explicit error or left unchanged?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and tested, but choosing whether user-supplied poll choices may be silently omitted is a product and interoperability policy decision rather than a defect that automation can resolve.

options.title: Accept builder truncation
options.body: Confirm that preserving a deliverable 20-answer Matrix event is preferable to rejecting existing oversized poll requests, and merge the current focused implementation.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Require an explicit Matrix-boundary validation error so callers must reduce the option list rather than losing choices silently.

options.title: Pause for protocol-owner guidance
options.body: Hold the PR until a Matrix-area owner verifies the desired interoperability behavior against supported homeserver and client expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept builder truncation
recommendation.body: Confirm that preserving a deliverable 20-answer Matrix event is preferable to rejecting existing oversized poll requests, and merge the current focused implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context does not establish a named current-main Matrix poll owner; assign this to the Matrix area after a history check.
